tasks.subject: Task 0: QueryProfile table + migrate 4 profiles off registry
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Flat governance.query_profiles table seeded deterministically from the active/latest registry's 4 profiles (Global, enabled).

**Files:** Modify app/models/query_profiles.py; Create alembic/versions/0022_query_profiles_table.py (revision 0022, down_revision 0021); Test tests/unit/test_query_profile_model.py

**Acceptance Criteria:** table with profile_key(str UNIQUE = existing QueryProfileDefinition.id) + label + source_id FK + enabled; deterministic active/latest registry migration mapping id→profile_key; assert exactly 4 migrated else literal 0018 NEW_PROFILES fallback; downgrade drops table.

**Verify:** docker exec eip-mmdpp-postgres-1 psql -U eip -d eip -tAc "SELECT profile_key,kind,source_id,enabled FROM governance.query_profiles ORDER BY profile_key" → 4 rows

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/models/query_profiles.py", "alembic/versions/0022_query_profiles_table.py", "tests/unit/test_query_profile_model.py"], "verifyCommand": "docker exec eip-mmdpp-postgres-1 psql -U eip -d eip -tAc \"SELECT profile_key,kind,source_id,enabled FROM governance.query_profiles ORDER BY profile_key\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["query_profiles table: profile_key(unique str) + label + source_id FK + enabled", "deterministic active/latest registry migration; map id→profile_key", "assert exactly 4 migrated, else literal 0018 NEW_PROFILES fallback", "downgrade drops table"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Service — table-backed profiles + Project-Source filtering
tasks.description:

**Files:** Modify app/services/query_profiles.py; Test tests/unit/test_query_profile_source_scope.py

**Acceptance Criteria:** table CRUD (by profile_key) replaces registry helpers; resolve filters EACH candidate set by source BEFORE _select_best_candidate; d.source_id predicate on BOTH evidence UNION branches (text :697 + image :723); include_associated_systems (:806) also source-filtered when scoped; None path unchanged (Global).

**Verify:** python3 -m pytest tests/unit/test_query_profile_source_scope.py -v

tasks.subject: Task 3: API — standalone profile CRUD + search; remove registry routes
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Expose profiles directly (no registry parent) + search endpoints, wired to table + source scope, keyed by profile_key.

**Files:** Modify app/api/v1/query_profiles.py, app/schemas/query_profiles.py; Test tests/integration/test_query_profiles_api.py

**Acceptance Criteria:** 6 registry routes deleted (registries POST → 404); flat profile CRUD GET/PUT/DELETE /v1/query-profiles/{profile_key} + search wired to table; external identifier is profile_key (search profile_id + dossier section_profile_ids resolve to it); create/update accept source_id + enabled; schemas add QueryProfileCreate/Update/Response (profile_key, label, source_id, enabled); keep validate_shape + RADAR/MISSILE frozenset.

**Verify:** curl -s localhost:8005/v1/query-profiles | python3 -m json.tool → 4 flat profiles; POST /v1/query-profiles/registries → 404

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/api/v1/query_profiles.py", "app/schemas/query_profiles.py", "tests/integration/test_query_profiles_api.py"], "verifyCommand": "curl -s localhost:8005/v1/query-profiles | python3 -m json.tool", "acceptanceCriteria": ["6 registry routes deleted (registries POST → 404)", "flat profile CRUD keyed by profile_key + search wired to table", "profile_key is external identifier (search/dossier cross-refs preserved)", "create/update accept source_id + enabled; RADAR/MISSILE frozenset kept"], "modelTier": "complex"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: UI — ontology-driven profile builder + Project Source

**Files:** Modify frontend/src/components/QueryProfileRegistryPage.tsx, QueryPage.tsx, api/client.ts, GraphExplorer.tsx

**Acceptance Criteria:** read-only ontology (no editor/registry controls); profile CRUD + Project Source dropdown (ingest.sources + Global) + Enabled toggle; profile_sections from /v1/ontology (not hardcoded); QueryPage lists profiles without active-registry gate; client.ts registry fns removed, profile CRUD + getOntology + listSources added.

**Verify:** running UI :3100 shows ontology read-only + 4 profiles; create w/ source persists; curl -s localhost:8005/v1/query-profiles reflects edits

```json:metadata
{"files": ["frontend/src/components/QueryProfileRegistryPage.tsx", "frontend/src/components/QueryPage.tsx", "frontend/src/api/client.ts", "frontend/src/components/GraphExplorer.tsx"], "verifyCommand": "curl -s localhost:8005/v1/query-profiles | python3 -m json.tool", "acceptanceCriteria": ["read-only ontology (no editor/registry controls)", "profile CRUD + Project Source dropdown + Enabled toggle", "profile_sections from ontology not hardcoded", "QueryPage lists profiles without active gate"], "modelTier": "complex"}
```
